meta.title: GraphQL Schema to TypeScript - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Paste GraphQL SDL to automatically convert type/interface/enum/input/union into TypeScript type definitions, with parse statistics.
desc: Paste GraphQL SDL to automatically convert type/interface/enum/input/union into TypeScript type definitions, with parse statistics.
ui.100: No type definitions parsed: please paste valid GraphQL SDL containing type/enum/input/union blocks
ui.101:
Paste GraphQL SDL, e.g.:
type User {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  email: String
  age: Int
}
enum Role {
  ADMIN
  USER
}
input UserInput {
  name: String!
}
union SearchResult = User | Article
